当前版本未被此游戏支持: This version is not supported by this game
版本按游戏保存，重开后继续使用。切换会停止当前修正，松开侧键后再按；其他设置保持: The version is saved per game and restored on restart. Switching stops the current correction; release and press the side key again. Other settings keep their current values for comparison.
本版本参与因素与字段: Factors and fields used by this version
使用后坐基准角、基准角速度及 tick/fraction，在本批原生模拟时间上按: Evaluates the base recoil angle, angular velocity and tick/fraction at this batch's native simulation time with the frozen E function, including native decay, integration, interpolation and scaling.
使用已读取的不可预测后坐基准与时间求值，再与 P 相加；不预测尚未收到的新射击或: Evaluates the received unpredictable base recoil and time, then adds P. Unknown future firing or damage impulses are not predicted.
普通本地预测输入使用 v_angle；网络角只属于对应已核验来源，不能替代缺失基: Ordinary local prediction uses v_angle. Network angles belong only to their verified source and do not replace a missing basis. Targets use the selected semantic bone and complete player handles.
使用敌我世界速度、可信读取年龄与手动预计执行延迟，平移相对位置并外推已知 P/U: Uses both players' world velocities, trustworthy sample age and the configured response delay to advance relative positions and known P/U. The default 20ms is a model assumption; all versions use the current setting.
最终导数由 Reader 按实际输入分支求值，已包含符号、灵敏度与开镜影响；使用: Reader evaluates the signed derivative for the actual input branch, including sensitivity and scope effects. Uses the native 1:1 assumption or an explicitly adopted measured ratio without applying those factors again.
侧键、会话、当前来源、明确死亡和完整数据资格仍统一核验；缺帧恢复原目标。速度档位: Side-key, session, source, explicit death and current-data checks remain shared. Missing frames resume the original target. Speed presets, step, interval and XY budgets follow current device capabilities; submitted motion is retired using the current response model.
相机 view-punch、视觉后坐与准星动画用于展示或来源核对；未再次叠加为子: Camera view-punch, visual recoil and crosshair animation are display or provenance data, not additional shot offsets. Spread and unknown future firing events are excluded.
固定保留 PC2.2.4 的计算方式：目标误差与后坐误差合并，统一经过原有比例追: Preserves PC2.2.4: target and recoil errors share the existing proportional tracking, acceleration, braking distance and optional learned model.
全部角差共用原有平滑。保留小数计数与待反映位移账本；该版本不加入后坐独立快速通道: All angular errors share the original smoothing, fractional counts and pending-motion ledger. This version has no separate fast recoil channel.
复用 v1 的全部后坐求值与字段，将已读取后坐偏移的变化交给快速通道；目标跟随保: Reuses v1 recoil evaluation and fields. Received recoil-offset changes use a fast channel while target tracking keeps the existing smoothing, for manual comparison of response and overshoot.
普通本地预测输入下，快速通道按后坐偏移变化优先分配计数，避开目标跟随的增益、起停: For direct local prediction input, recoil-offset changes receive priority counts without the tracking gain, start/stop acceleration or variation. Total rate, step and XY limits still apply. Smoothing receives only the remaining error to avoid double compensation.
第一次锁定、缺组恢复或模拟时间路线不连续时重建差分参考，当前帧使用基线跟随；其他: Initial lock, missing-group recovery or a discontinuous simulation route rebuilds the differential reference using baseline tracking for that sample. Other basis branches or disabled recoil use baseline motion. Rejected proposals roll back the fast-channel state without losing or double-counting motion.
保留 PUBG 当前算法与运动方式；本游戏现有 v1 可选，后续实验版本将单独加: Preserves current PUBG calculations and motion. This game currently offers v1; later experiments will be added separately.
使用当前语义瞄准部位、完整目标身份、敌我三维坐标与世界速度，以及 Living/: Uses the current semantic aim part, complete target identity, both players' 3D positions and velocities, Living/Local pairing and trustworthy time compensation.
使用当前枪械资料、弹速与衰减积分、可设置重力、飞行时间及归零规则；按当前资格选用: Uses current weapon data, bullet speed and drag integration, configurable gravity, flight time and zeroing. Current eligibility selects Reader's native shot reference or the equivalent camera model.
使用当前灵敏度/FOV 换算或已采用校准、设备握手能力与比例速度、既有平滑、待反: Uses current sensitivity/FOV mapping or adopted calibration, negotiated capabilities and relative speed, existing smoothing, pending motion and the optional learned model. The version selector does not change those calculations.
当前眼角分支使用基线运动: This eye-basis branch uses baseline motion
后坐补偿已关闭，使用基线运动: Recoil compensation is off; using baseline motion
目标跟随与后坐差分已就绪: Target tracking and recoil differential ready
v1固定保留PC2.2.4的合并误差平滑；v2复用相同P/U、眼角与时序求值，将: v1 preserves PC2.2.4 merged-error smoothing. v2 uses the same P/U, eye basis and timing, with a fast channel for known recoil-offset changes and v1 smoothing for residual target tracking. Tracking gain, acceleration and variation do not delay the fast part; total speed, per-step and XY limits still apply. Discontinuous simulation routes reset the differential reference without predicting unknown impulses. Stable version IDs are saved per game and switching clears old motion.
后坐变化优先使用独立计数通道，平滑跟随只处理扣除该部分后的剩余角差，全部已接受位: Recoil changes receive priority counts; smooth tracking handles only the remaining angle. All accepted motion shares one ledger to prevent duplicate compensation. Initial lock or a discontinuous time route resets the reference. Non-direct input branches or disabled recoil use baseline motion. Rejected proposals roll back the fast state and fractional budget while preserving accepted tracking state. Physical side-key, session and source checks remain shared.
平滑跟随＋后坐快速通道: Smooth tracking with fast recoil channel
移动算法根据已计算的剩余角差、时间与设备能力生成鼠标计数，独立于目标选择和后坐求: The movement algorithm converts the computed residual angle, timing and device capabilities into mouse counts, independently of target selection and recoil evaluation.
按游戏保存；切换会清理当前运动和待反馈位移，松开侧键后再按。Rage共用此处选择: Saved per game. Changing this clears current movement and pending counts; release and press the side button again. Rage shares this selection; RCS keeps its own behavior.
沿用所选版本的原有移动方式：v1/v4为平滑跟随，v2为后坐变化快速通道，v3为: Preserve the selected version's original movement: smooth tracking for v1/v4, the fast recoil-change channel for v2, and direct quantization for v3. Existing configurations default to this choice.
剩余角差经过比例追赶、加减速与停止距离约束，再生成鼠标计数。继续使用当前速度档位: Generate mouse counts from the residual angle using proportional tracking, acceleration, deceleration and stopping distance. Current speed, device limits and the enabled learned model still apply.
已核验的后坐变化优先生成计数，其他剩余误差继续平滑跟随；首次或时间不连续时重建差: Verified recoil changes receive priority; the remaining error uses smooth tracking. Rebuild the differential baseline on startup or timing discontinuities. The fast channel requires verified local prediction input; other sources or disabled recoil compensation use smooth tracking.
将完整剩余角差直接换算为鼠标计数，保留速度、学习模型速度上限和设备预算，跳过比例: Convert the full residual angle directly into mouse counts, retaining speed, learned speed limits and device budgets while bypassing proportional tracking, acceleration and lateral variation.
单变量对照组固定使用v1平滑基线及该组因素；独立移动选择暂不生效，退出对照组后恢: Single-factor comparisons use the fixed v1 smooth baseline and their declared factor. The independent movement selection resumes after leaving the comparison.
这里保留历史方案及字段说明；其中的移动说明描述历史默认行为。鼠标移动可在独立模块: Historical presets and field descriptions remain here. Their movement descriptions refer to the historical default. Choose movement independently below, or use the historical preset to preserve the original behavior.
保留当前PUBG的轨迹规划、目标跟踪与平滑计数规则；仅拆分移动模块，原有数值不变: Preserve the current PUBG trajectory planning, target tracking and smooth count generation. The movement module is separated without changing its existing values.
按游戏保存；切换会清理当前运动和待反馈位移，松开侧键后再按。: Saved per game. Changing this clears current movement and pending counts; release and press the side button again.
Rage共用此处选择，RCS保持自身逻辑。: Rage shares this movement selection. RCS keeps its own behavior.
沿用此游戏所选方案原有的移动方式，保留旧配置的默认行为。: Use this game's selected preset's original movement, preserving the default behavior of existing configurations.
